title: GC runner unpins but does not delete articles row — orphaned CID re-selected every run
description: gc.rs GcRunner::run_once calls pin_client.unpin() but never deletes the row from the articles table. gc_executor.rs run_gc_executor DOES delete the row, but GcRunner::run_once (called by start_gc_scheduler) does not call gc_executor — it calls pin_client.unpin() directly. Result: unpinned CIDs remain in the articles table and are re-selected as GC candidates on every subsequent hourly run, triggering redundant unpin calls indefinitely. Correctness invariant: after GC, unpinned CIDs must be removed from the articles table and msgid_map (as gc_executor already knows).
